scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hey hey. I don't have time for chit-chat, I'm a pretty busy guy. There's all these Merchants working hard to become Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
喂喂，我可没空闲聊，忙着呢。
这么多商人，都在努力成为铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Wait a minute, I think I've met you before.
Ummm.....
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
等等，好像以前见过你。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you the one who broke my weapon and ran away? Or are you the one who tortured me so that I'd forge a weapon for you? Why can't I remember?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你是那个弄坏我的武器然后逃跑的人吗？还是那个折磨我，逼我为你打造武器的人？我怎么想不起来了？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
.......
I can't remember who you are for the life of me. Is this deja vu?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
...
怎么也想不起你是谁，是似曾相识的感觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Argh!! This is really bugging me! But still, I can sense that there's something special about you. Oh well, whatever. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
啊！！真让人烦躁！不过，感觉你确实有些特别。
算了，不管了，祝你今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Welcome!
We are Workers of Steel,
the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
欢迎！我们是钢铁工匠——铁匠公会。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
We pour the fervor
and passion of our souls into
our craft. Our skills of melting metal into new weapons
and tools is truly a form of art!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
我们将心中的热忱与激情倾注于技艺。
熔炼金属，打造新的武器和工具，这本身就是一门艺术！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You... look like a stranger. But somehow it seems that you're related to our guild. Haha~
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你...看着眼生，却总觉得和我们公会有些关系。
哈哈~我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh~
what a very
pretty lady!
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦~真是位漂亮的姑娘！
想成为铁匠吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
想成为铁匠吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
First, you must become a Merchant before you can become a Blacksmith. Go to the city of Alberta to learn the Merchant trade.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
首先，你必须成为商人，然后才能成为铁匠。去艾尔贝塔学习商人的技艺吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh, are you interested in having a weapon forged? I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I actually have a lot of business to attend to.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦，想请人打造武器？
抱歉让你失望了，我现在还有一大堆事要忙。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh...
There's not much we can offer you here. And you can't really help out around here unless you know how to make stuff...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦...这里没什么能帮到你的。
不会制作东西的话，你也帮不上什么忙...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh? What's a magic user doing here? I'm surprised. Usually this kind of rough work is beneath you intellectual types.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦？会魔法的人怎么来了？真意外。
你们这些有学问的人，通常不屑于干这种粗活吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Am I correct in assuming you're a member of the Clergy? Would you please bless me before you leave!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦！我猜得没错的话，你是神职人员吧？在你离开之前，请为我祝福一下！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry...
But there really isn't anything for you to steal here. Well, there are the Daggers we keep in the back, but...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
抱歉...这里真没什么好偷的。
倒是后面放着些短剑，不过...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
So how's the pharmacy business going on recently?
Well, my forging business does not seem to grow any longer.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
最近药剂生意怎么样？
我的锻造生意，倒是没什么起色了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Long time no see.
Have you come to purchase supplies from Christopher? These days I'm stuck behind this desk. My body's itching to strike the ol' anvil.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦！好久不见。
来找克里斯托弗买材料？
最近我整天被困在这张桌子后，早就手痒，想回去敲铁砧了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
技能点没用完，不能转职为铁匠。
好好分配完技能点，再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Why don't you stop struggling
to make zeny as a Merchant and
join the elite Blacksmith class?
If you're interested, fill out this application with your name
and Job Level.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
别再当商人辛苦赚Zeny了，来成为精英铁匠吧？
有兴趣的话，就填好这张申请表，写上名字和职业等级。

scripts.text: Fill out Application.
scripts.translation: 填写申请表

scripts.text: What are the requirements?
scripts.translation: 有什么要求？

scripts.text: Um, I need to think about it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
技能点没用完，不能转职为铁匠。
好好分配完技能点，再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Looks like you
meet the Job Level
Requirement.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯...看来你的职业等级符合要求。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You see, we don't accept just anybody into our guild. First, we only accept experienced Merchants with a true desire to become great Blacksmiths. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
我们公会可不是谁都收。
首先，得是经验丰富、一心想成为优秀铁匠的商人。
让我看看...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Shuffling of papers*^000000

[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
One of our Blacksmiths in Einbech, ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 has sent us word that he's short on help. Your first test of character will be to help him out.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯...艾音贝赫的铁匠^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000来信，说缺人帮忙。
第一项品行考验，就是去帮他。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Be careful
and good luck!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
小心点，祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm, it seems that you lack experience as a Merchant. We require that you are at least Job Level 40, you see.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯，商人经验还不够。
职业等级至少得达到40级才行。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I feel bad turning you away after you've come so far, but rules are rules. Sorry to disappoint you, but we'll welcome you back once you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
让你大老远来却空手而归，我也过意不去，不过规矩就是规矩。
抱歉让你失望了，准备好了再来，我们随时欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You want to know our requirements? First, you need to have Job Level 40 or higher as a Merchant. Second, you need to pass a test that will be given by the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
想知道转职条件？
首先，商人职业等级至少40级。
其次，通过铁匠公会的测试。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
The test may consist of difficult tasks, but it's definitely not impossible. You will need to deliver certain items to different areas around the world
to complete the test.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
测试里会有些困难的任务，但绝不是做不到。
你需要把指定物品送到世界各地，才能完成测试。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Well, I hope
to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯...希望还能见到你。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You haven't left yet?
Go to Einbech and find ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000. Finish helping him out, and when you're done, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你还没走吗？
去艾音贝赫找^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000。帮他完成工作，结束后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Was the work you did for ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 to your liking? He's known for being pretty exacting...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
给^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000帮忙，感觉怎么样？
他可是出了名的要求严格...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Great job!!
You have passed
the first test...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
干得漂亮！！第一项测试通过了...

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hm? You look surprised.
I guess you didn't know that there's more than one test. 
Haha, but don't worry, you are not going to travel that far.
Please go talk to the guildsman inside the building for more details about your next test.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
咦？你看起来很惊讶。
看来你不知道测试不止一个。
哈哈，不过别担心，你不需要跑那么远。
请去楼里找公会成员，了解下一次测试的详细信息。

scripts.text: I want to change my job quickly! But...oh well.
scripts.translation: 我想快点转职！不过...算了

scripts.text: Grrr! Enough is enough!
scripts.translation: 哼！受够了！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry, but I'm sure you understand, right? We can't just casually accept anybody into
our guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
抱歉，不过你也能理解吧？
我们不能随随便便就让人加入公会！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
If we don't keep our standards,
we won't be able to maintain the respectability of the Blacksmith Guild!
We can't embarass our guild in this manner! *Ahem* Anyway, you talk to the guildsman inside the building now.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
不坚持标准，怎么维护铁匠公会的声誉！
不能让公会这样丢脸！*咳*
总之，现在去找楼里的公会成员吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you saying you're going
to quit the application process? That's an insult to our guild!
Get out of here! With that kind of attitude, you can forget becoming a member of the Blacksmith Guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你是说，要放弃申请？这是在侮辱公会！
给我出去！这种态度，别想加入铁匠公会！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You have no spirit!
If you can't endure this, you'll never be a Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你毫无斗志！
如果你连这点都坚持不了，就永远成不了铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Um? Haven't you talk to the guildsman yet?
If you haven't, I suggest you to do so as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯？你还没找公会成员谈过吗？
如果没有的话，我建议你尽快去办。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You are on a riding pet, so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你正骑着宠物，无法转职。
请卸下坐骑后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Excellent, I can tell by the twinkle in your eye that you were successful. I can now bestow upon you the gift of the smithing, the art of the Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
很好，看你眼中的光芒，就知道成功了。
现在，我可以授予你铁匠的锻造技艺了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Always remember that we are creators, and artists over metals. Be wary that you do not fall into the pitfalls of selfishness
and greed.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
永远记住，我们是创造者，是以金属为媒介的艺术家。
别陷入自私和贪婪。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Here is a little
gift to mark the
beginning of your
life as a Blacksmith.
Congratulations!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
这是一份小礼物，以纪念你铁匠生涯的开始。
恭喜！！！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hello there!
I'm ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000,
a Blacksmith by trade.
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你好！我是^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000，做铁匠的。
很高兴认识你！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Oh ho ho!
You're a Merchant!
Excellent! I was
in need of some help!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
哦呵呵！你是商人！
太好了，我正缺人帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
But, of course,
I wouldn't bother you
if you're busy. Go along
your way if you must~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不过，你要是忙，我就不打扰了。
有事要办，就先去吧~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
After all...
I should know
how it's like
to be busy~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
毕竟...忙起来是什么滋味，我可太清楚了~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Am I correct in assuming you are the help sent by the Blacksmith Guild? There aren't many trustyworthy people I can hire to help me, so I'm always
short on help.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我猜得没错的话，你就是铁匠公会派来的帮手吧？我很少能雇到值得信赖的人帮忙，所以总是人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm, in any case,
you are the help that was sent, right? Okay, I have some work for you that must be handled
right away!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯，总之，你就是派来的帮手，对吧？
好，有些工作得请你马上处理！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Some time ago, I had a boy working for me who had no experience and bought the wrong supplies! It was terrible...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不久前，我雇了一个没有经验的男孩，结果他买错了材料！太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Anyone would hate to lose money through a foolish mistake like that. However, I have a slightly more difficult job for you.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
谁都不愿意因为这种糊涂事亏钱。
不过，我交给你的工作会稍微难一些。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
However, I want to make sure that you have some basic knowledge as a Merchant. I'd like to ask you some questions, if that's okay.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
先确认一下，你是否具备商人的基础知识。
不介意的话，我问你几个问题。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Um, can I have some time to prepare?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以花点时间准备一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
So, have you
studied a little
more this time?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
那么，这次多学了些知识吗？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I admit that it's pretty unreasonable to expect anyone to get a perfect score the first time around, so I'll give you
a little break...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
第一次就要求人人拿满分，确实不太合理。
所以，这次放宽一点...

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You can miss
one problem!
Alright, let's start
with the questions~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
可以错一道题！
好，开始提问~

[Geschupenschte]
1. Which one of the following regions is matched incorrectly
with its specialty item?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
1. 以下哪个地区与特产的配对有误？

scripts.translation: 梦罗克 - 盗贼之衣

scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔 - 双手斧

scripts.translation: 克魔岛 - 菠色克药水

scripts.text: Alberta - Swordmace
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔 - 尖刃铁锤

[Geschupenschte]
2. What status can
be inflicted with the
^8E6B23Hammer Fall^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
2. ^8E6B23大地之击^000000技能能造成哪种异常状态？

scripts.translation: 眩晕

scripts.translation: 黑暗

3. 以下哪个技能是商人无法使用的？

scripts.translation: 露天商店

scripts.translation: 低价买进

scripts.translation: 高价卖出

scripts.translation: 加速术

4. Where can you find a store
that sells Blue Gemstones?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
4. 哪里的商店出售蓝色魔力矿石？

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
5. Where is the
Tool Dealer
located in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
5. 吉芬的工具店位于哪里？

scripts.text: 8 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场的8点钟方向

scripts.text: 11 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场的11点钟方向

scripts.translation: 城镇广场的6点钟方向

scripts.text: 5 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 城镇广场的5点钟方向

[Geschupenschte]
6. Which weapon
cannot be used
by a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
6. 商人无法使用哪种武器？

scripts.text: Stiletto
scripts.translation: 双刃短剑

scripts.text: Ring Pommel Saber
scripts.translation: 圆柄马刀

scripts.text: Chain
scripts.translation: 锁链

scripts.text: Bible
scripts.translation: 圣经

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
7. Which one of the following
has the highest defense rate?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
7. 以下哪件装备的防御力最高？

scripts.text: Panties
scripts.translation: 内裤

scripts.text: Mink Coat
scripts.translation: 毛皮大衣

scripts.text: Wooden Mail
scripts.translation: 木制盔甲

scripts.text: Silk Robe
scripts.translation: 丝质外袍

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
8. For Level 3 weapons,
what is the ^8E6B23Safe^000000 limit
for upgrading?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
8. 3级武器的^8E6B23安全^000000精炼上限是多少？

scripts.text: up to + 3
scripts.translation: 最高+3

scripts.text: up to + 4
scripts.translation: 最高+4

scripts.text: up to + 5
scripts.translation: 最高+5

scripts.text: up to + 6
scripts.translation: 最高+6

scripts.text:
9. What item
can be made using
the ^8E6B23Trunks^000000 item?
scripts.translation: 9. 使用^8E6B23玛哪树枝^000000可以制作出什么物品？

scripts.text: Sakkat
scripts.translation: 草帽

scripts.text: Ghost Bandana
scripts.translation: 亡者发箍

scripts.translation: 山羊头盔

scripts.text: Antler
scripts.translation: 鹿角头饰

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
10. The most important
part of being a Merchant is...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
10. 作为商人，最重要的是...？

scripts.text: Credit
scripts.translation: 信用

scripts.text: Integrity
scripts.translation: 诚信

scripts.text: Money
scripts.translation: 金钱

scripts.text: Rhetoric
scripts.translation: 口才

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
1. Among the following cities, which one is not correctly matched with its specialty?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
1. 以下哪座城市与其特产的搭配不正确？

a receipt?
What...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你的意思是...
你没拿到收据？
什么...？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
A receipt is
a Merchant's best friend!
It's necessary to your job!
You'll have to start your
test all over again!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
收据可是商人最好的朋友！
做生意少不了它！
你的考验得从头再来一遍！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Return when you
find the receipt~
You didn't forget
to receive a receipt.
Right...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
找到收据再回来吧~
你没忘记要收据吧？
对吧...？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Thank you
very much
your help.
Return to Einbroch
and see ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
真是太感谢你帮忙了。
回艾音布罗克找^8E6B23阿尔蒂雷根^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm...?
You already finished
your test here with me!
And surprisingly, I don't
need any more help, today.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯...？
你已经通过我这里的考验了！
而且难得的是，我今天也没什么事需要帮忙了。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Being
a Blacksmith
is truly great!
Don't you think so?
Mwahahahahah!!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
当铁匠真是太棒了！
你不觉得吗？
Mwahahahahah!!

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh, hello!
Have you come
to deliver my
Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
哦，你好！
你是来送我订的言灵魔杖的吗？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You sure this is what I ordered, right? I mean, if it's been used,
I don't want it.
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
你确定这就是我订的那把吧？
我是说，用过的我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is one of the items I use...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是我自己用的装备...

scripts.text: I'm sure! It's brand new!
scripts.translation: 我确定！是全新的！

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Well...
I guess I can
wait a little longer.
Please hurry with
my delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
好吧...
那我就再等等。
请尽快把我订的货送来~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You're
absolutely sure?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
你真的确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you so much for traveling all the way here. That Geschupenschte, please smack him for me when you meet him for being so late on this order...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
谢谢你大老远跑来送货。
那个格舒彭什特，订单拖了这么久，你见到他时，替我揍他一顿...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Please wait
a second, let
me give you a receipt~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
稍等一下，我给你开张收据~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Here it is.
Thank you so much!
Oh, and good luck~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
给你。
非常感谢！
哦，祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you
so much for
the delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
谢谢你帮忙送货~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh...
It's been a while
since I've been
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
哦...
我好久没去艾尔贝塔了。

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I ordered something
from there a while ago,
but I haven't received
my delivery...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
前些日子我在那里订了东西，到现在还没送来...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I wonder...
Could the Blacksmith Guild
be undermanned? I can't think of any other reason for them to be late...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
难道...
铁匠公会人手不够？
除了这个，我也想不出他们迟迟不送货的原因...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
When will I get
my special Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我什么时候才能收到特制的言灵魔杖呢？

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...!
It's here!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
...！
终于到了！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
This is what I ordered, right?
I don't want any used or old Gladius that you might have!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
这就是我订的那把吧？
你身上那些用过的旧长柄短剑，我可不要！

scripts.text: Whoops, not that one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，不是那把

scripts.text: I guarantee you it is new.
scripts.translation: 我保证是全新的

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oooh...!
Hurry up
with my Gladius~
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
Oooh...!
快把我的长柄短剑送来~

scripts.text: - She seems to be upset. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起来很生气。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Hah hah hah!
Finally! Now...
Let me have
a look!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
Hah hah hah!
终于来了！
那么...让我看看！

scripts.text: - She looks very happy. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起来很高兴。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Are you with the
Einbroch Blacksmith Guild?
Give this message to Geschupenschte!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
你是艾音布罗克铁匠公会的人吗？
替我给格舒彭什特带个话！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
'^660000You're late!
Do you know how long
I've been waiting?!^000000'
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
“^660000你送货太慢了！
知道我等了多久吗？！^000000”

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
But, this is also
a masterfully crafted item.
Tell him I'm satisfied with the quality of the workmanship.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
不过，这件东西做得确实精良。
告诉他，我对做工很满意。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Here's the receipt.
I think you did
a good job.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
这是收据。
我觉得你做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Thanks for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
谢谢你帮忙送货。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
......

[Wickebine]
They're late.
They're late,
they're late,
they're late~!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
送货太慢了。
太慢了，太慢了，太慢了~！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
How long does it take for something to ship from Geschupenschte? Usually, the Geffen Blacksmith Guild is pretty prompt...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
格舒彭什特送个货到底要多久？
吉芬铁匠公会平时送货都挺快的啊...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Ooohh...
This is very
upsetting...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
Ooohh...
真让人心烦...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ohhhhhh~
Is it here?
Very nice.
Let me take a look.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
Ohhhhhh~
货到了吗？
很好。
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
So you're sure this is the item
I ordered, right? I wouldn't want it if it's been used.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你确定这就是我订的东西吧？
用过的我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this one is used!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这把是用过的！

scripts.text: It was just made, so it's new.
scripts.translation: 刚做好的，是全新的

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Hmmmmm!
Please deliver
the right sword!
I've been waiting
long enough already...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
Hmmmmm!
请把我订的那把剑送来！
我已经等得够久了...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
You double checked?
Alright then, I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你确认过了？
好吧，我收下！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Oh ho...
This is good.
Much better than
what I expected.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
哦呵呵...
不错。
比我预期的要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
With this sword...
My special moves will be even more powerful! I may even be able to perfect my fast attacking techniques! I love it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
有了这把剑...
我的绝招会更厉害！
说不定还能让我的快攻技巧达到完美！
我太喜欢了！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Okay then.
Let me give
you a receipt.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
好，那我给你开张收据。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Here is
your receipt.
Thank you for
your business!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
这是你的收据。
感谢惠顾！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Thank you
for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
谢谢你帮忙送货。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
......

When will the sword
I ordered finally arrive?
I need to try my ultimate skill, ^2F4F4FFine Edge^000000 with it.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
我订的剑到底什么时候才能到？
我还要用它试试我的终极绝招——^2F4F4F利刃^000000呢。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ahhhhhhh!
I need to
have that sword!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
Ahhhhhhh!
我一定要拿到那把剑！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Oh~
Is it finally here?
The package I ordered?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
哦~
我订的包裹终于到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Um, this is what I ordered, right? I don't want an Arbalest that's been used before.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
嗯，这就是我订的东西吧？
用过的埃布尔雷弓我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is a used one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这把是用过的

scripts.text: I'm sure it's new.
scripts.translation: 我确定是全新的

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Hmmmm.
Please hurry
and bring the
correct item.
I've waited too
long already...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
Hmmmm.
请赶快把我订的东西送来。
我已经等得太久了...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
So, you're sure?
Let me take a look...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
你确定吧？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
*wheet whoo*
Very nice!!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
*wheet whoo*
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
This is truly a quality made custom item. I love how there is a case for an eye patch! I really reallly love this~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
这件定制装备的做工真不错。
居然还有个放眼罩的盒子，太合我心意了！
我真是太喜欢了~

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Thank you!
For something of this quality,
I can even sell it for a high price even after I've used it!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
谢谢！
品质这么好的东西，就算我用过了，也能卖个好价钱！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Here!
Please take
your receipt.
I really appreciate
your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
给！
请收好收据。
辛苦你了，真是非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Really,
I can't say it
enough. This is
top quality work~!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
真的，再怎么夸也不为过。
这做工真是一流~！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Eh...
When will my
order arrive?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
呃...
我订的东西什么时候才能到？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
A custom made Arbalest
with a quality case to hold your eye patches. Only one person can make something like that...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
定制的埃布尔雷弓，还配有放眼罩的精美盒子。
这种东西只有一个人做得出来...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Ahhhhhh...
The waiting
is unbearable!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
Ahhhhhh...
这样等下去实在受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Sweet God...
Have you sent
an angel...?
Is that the Ring Pommel Saber
I ordered? It's my only hope...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
上帝啊...
是您派天使来了吗...？
那是我订的圆柄马刀吗？
那可是我唯一的希望...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Huuuk*^000000 This is what I ordered, right? I needed one especially
made to stop this poison...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
^666666*Huuuk*^000000这就是我订的那把吧？
我是特意定制来解毒的...

scripts.text: Whoops, this is my own Ring Pommel Saber.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是我自己的圆柄马刀

scripts.text: I'm sure this is the one.
scripts.translation: 我确定就是这把

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
N-Nooo...
Hurry...!
I need that
sword for its
an...ti...d-dote!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
不、不行...
快点...！
我需要那把剑来解...解...毒！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like
he's slowly dying...!
You'd better hurry.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他好像正在慢慢死去...！
你最好快点。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghklk*^000000
Give it...!
Pleeeease!

^3355FFBismarc stabs
himself, repeatedly,
with the Ring Pommel Saber
that has been imbued with
the power of Green Herbs.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF俾斯麦用那把蕴含绿色药草之力的圆柄马刀，一次又一次刺向自己。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
*Gasp gasp*
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
*Gasp gasp*

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Please...
Help me up.
The poison is
still coarsing
through my body...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
请...
扶我起来。
毒素还在我体内肆虐...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
OwwwWWWW!!
IT'S BURNING!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
OwwwWWWW!!
烧起来了！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
*Gasp Gasp*
*Whew* Okay,
I can feel the
antidote working now.
Just what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
*Gasp Gasp*
*Whew*好了，我能感觉到解毒剂开始起作用了。
正是我需要的。

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Here is
your receipt.
T-take it...!
It's yours!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
这是你的收据。
拿、拿着...！
给你的！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Thank you.
You saved
my life...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
谢谢你。
你救了我的命...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
^666666*Huk Hukk*^000000
When will my
o-order arrive...?
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
^666666*Huk Hukk*^000000
我订...订的东西什么时候才能到...？

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
The poison in
my body... the pain...
excruciating... L-lord...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
我体内的毒...痛得...受不了了...
主、主啊...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
When is the
antidote gonna
get here?!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
解毒剂到底什么时候才能到？！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Oh...so you're the one who wants to be a blacksmith?
Nice, heh heh.
As you've realized from your past tests, you won't be promoted from Merchant to Blacksmtih immediately.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
哦...你就是想当铁匠的人啊？
不错，呵呵。
经过前面的考验，你也知道了，商人可不是说转职就能成为铁匠的。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
How much do you truly understand about smithing? Are you ready for me to ask you some questions?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
你对锻造究竟了解多少？
准备好让我提问了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, not yet~
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好~

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Alright...
My test is simple.
I'll ask five questions.
If you miss too many,
you fail. And I won't
tell you what you missed.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
好...
我的考验很简单，就问五道题。
错得太多就不及格。
而且我不会告诉你错了哪几道。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Please listen
and answer carefully...
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
请仔细听题，认真作答...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
1. What ability
is required to learn
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
1. 学习^8E6B23低价买进^000000需要先学会什么技能？

scripts.text: Level 3 Push Cart
scripts.translation: 3级手推车使用

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鉴定

scripts.text: Level 10 Mammonite
scripts.translation: 10级金钱攻击

scripts.text: Level 3 Enlarge Weight
scripts.translation: 3级负重量上升

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
2. When you attack
with ^8E6B23Hammerfall^000000,
what status effect can
you inflict on enemies?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
2. 用^8E6B23大地之击^000000攻击，可以让敌人陷入什么异常状态？

scripts.text: Stun
scripts.translation: 眩晕

scripts.text: Blindness
scripts.translation: 黑暗

scripts.text: Chaos
scripts.translation: 混乱

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

[Mitehmaeeuh]

when attacking with the
mastered Mammonite skill?

scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
3. 使用满级金钱攻击时，每次攻击会消耗多少Zeny？

scripts.text: 900 Zeny
scripts.translation: 900 Zeny

scripts.text: 1000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: 2000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 2000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
4. What is the
discount rate when
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000
skill is mastered?

[米特梅乌]
4. ^8E6B23低价买进^000000满级时，能获得多少折扣？

[Mitehmaeeuh]
5. What is the maximum
percentage that you can
overcharge items sold to
NPCs after mastering the

[米特梅乌]
5. ^8E6B23高价卖出^000000满级时，卖给NPC的物品最多能加价百分之多少？

following monsters

[米特梅乌]
1. 以下哪种魔物会掉落钢铁？

scripts.translation: 风灵原石

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Ah...
You've completed
the quiz. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
啊...
你答完了。
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
You earned
{0} points...
Very nice!
Congratulations!
You just passed!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
你得了{0}分...
很不错！
恭喜你！
你通过了！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
You earned
{0} points...
You failed! You better study up before coming back here.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
你得了{0}分...
没通过！
先回去好好学学，再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
However, don't let your early success make you overconfident. A Blacksmith's life isn't a picnic. As proof that you have passed the test, I give you this Hammer of Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
不过，可别因为这点成功就得意忘形。
铁匠的生活可不轻松。
这个高级铁砧就给你，作为通过考验的证明。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Take this Hammer
of Blacksmith and go back to the Altiregen. Okay then? I wish you the best of luck!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
带着这个高级铁砧回阿尔蒂雷根那里去，好吗？
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
With your knowledge, or lack thereof, you'll just end up hurting yourself holding a hammer!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
就你这点知识——或者说，你根本没学到什么——拿起锤子只会伤到自己！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Okay then.
Please prepare
yourself and return
when you are ready...
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
好，那你先去准备，准备好了再回来...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Yeap, you just passed the Blacksmith job test~
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
没错，你已经通过铁匠转职考验了~

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Why don't you go back to Mr.Altiregen?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
怎么还不回去找阿尔蒂雷根先生呢？

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Don't forget to bring the Hammer of Blacksmith with you!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
别忘了带上高级铁砧！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Oh, also make sure that you have no skill point left before you change your job~
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
哦，还有，转职前别忘了把技能点全部用完~

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
I had to deal with the heat when I was in Morocc,
and now I have to deal with the smog in this Einbroch!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
在梦罗克时得忍受酷热，到了艾音布罗克，又得忍受烟雾！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
But, I must admit that this is the perfect place for Blacksmiths because we have an abundance of crafting material supplies as well as highly developed equipment.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
不过，我得承认，这里确实是铁匠的理想之地。
材料供应充足，设备也很先进。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
We, Blacksmiths are trying our best to forge the best of the best weapons.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
我们铁匠一直竭尽全力，要锻造出最顶尖的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
We pledge our honor on that!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
我们以荣誉担保！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Good day, are you here to visit Blacksmith Guild?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
你好，你是来参观铁匠公会的吗？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I thank you for coming this far to visit our guild. However, I regret to inform you that Blacksmith Guild has been
moved to ^3131FF'Einbroch' in the Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
感谢您远道而来参观公会。
不过，很遗憾，铁匠公会已经搬到^3131FF修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的“艾音布罗克”^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
You can travel to Schwarzwald Republic by using the airship.
I can provide you a teleport service to Izlude, where you can use the airship.
Would you like to move to Izlude immediately?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
您可以乘坐飞空艇前往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国。
我可以把您传送到依斯鲁得岛，那里就能搭乘飞空艇。
您要现在前往依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: How to go to Einbroch
scripts.translation: 如何前往艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 好！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Oops, haven't you used the airship yet?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
哎呀，您还没坐过飞空艇吗？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Unlike Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic has 'the airship' instead of teleport services to move between towns.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
和卢恩·米德加兹王国不同，修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的城镇间交通不是靠传送服务，而是靠飞空艇。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
In ^3131FF'Izlude'^000000, you can use ^3131FF'the international airship'^000000 which travels between ^3131FFIzlude and Juno in Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
在^3131FF依斯鲁得岛^000000，您可以搭乘^3131FF国际飞空艇^000000，往返于^3131FF依斯鲁得岛和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的朱诺^000000之间。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Take the airship, and go to Juno. Then from Juno, you need to take ^3131FFthe domestic airship^000000 to go to Einbroch.
Remember, you are ^3131FFnot going outside of the airport^000000 upon transit from the international to the domestic airship.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
先乘飞空艇到朱诺，再换乘^3131FF国内飞空艇^000000前往艾音布罗克。
记住，从国际飞空艇换乘国内飞空艇时，^3131FF不要走出机场^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
It might sound complicated, but you will know once you are in the airport.
When you arrive in Blacksmith Guild, please send my regard to my coworkers!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
听起来可能有点复杂，不过到了机场，您就明白了。
到铁匠公会后，请代我向同事们问好！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Excuse me, but you do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
抱歉，您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Please take care!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
请多保重！
